items.title: Oracle Stock Gets Much-Needed Boost From Pentagon Software Deal
items.summary: Oracle stock climbed in early trading Friday after the enterprise technology company won a software deal with the Pentagon that could be worth $7 billion over the next decade.  Oracle has been a Pentagon contractor since the early 1990s, the company noted in its news release.  Oracle stock was up more than 2% to 122.70 in recent trades on the stock market today.
